terra.problem: The pop quiz joke brings in a school scenario, which Papa Dorin avoids.
“No angel in this scene” asserts that no angel was present. The passage does not say that; it simply does not mention one.
The explanation repeats that no angel is mentioned without adding much beyond the answer. It sounds flat and generic.
“Jesus isn't whispering here” assigns Jesus a volume the text does not give.
Jesus mentions the chief priests in verse 21, two verses earlier, not one.
“Wrong spot” uses “wrong” about the baker's answer.
“It sounds backwards on purpose” assigns an intent to Jesus that the text does not state.
“Jesus meant it to be” a surprise assigns an intent that the text does not state.
